indicator_name: Republican budget revenue: adjusted annual plan
description: Доходы республиканского бюджета: годовой уточнённый план
methodology: Built from 15 of 15 listed 'Statistical bulletin' documents (0 skipped). Million KZT, republican budget: the ADJUSTED PLAN FOR THE WHOLE YEAR as printed in the edition for January-<month> (sheet «табл 2»), dated the last day of that month -- not a year-to-date flow. It changes when the budget is revised; compare with the year-to-date execution of the same date.
